title: Cape Girardeau crash with small bodies and priest
summary: John Blitch tells of Cape Girardeau crash with small bodies and priest, about pre-Roswell (1941); visited 2014 at Cape Girardeau, Missouri, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
there
was bodies small diminutive bodies that

deliver last rights to because
apparently one of them was still alive

plain: A scientist named John Blitch, who worked for DARPA, the US military's advanced research agency, and who says he was taken by an alien, tells of a crash near Cape Girardeau, Missouri, around 1941, years before the famous 1947 crash story at Roswell, New Mexico. He says there were small bodies at the site, and a priest or reverend was asked to give last rites because one of them was apparently still alive, and he says he visited the place in 2014. If true, it would mean a crash with living beings happened before any of the better-known ones.
